verdict.rationale: Codex documents signing in with a ChatGPT account instead of managing API keys, and treats API-key use as the alternative that needs extra setup. The plans named for that sign-in are all paid tiers (Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, Enterprise), so free-tier access is not evidenced. missing for 10: evidence that a free ChatGPT account grants Codex access, documented free-tier limits/quotas, independent corroboration of the sign-in flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: Run `codex` and select **Sign in with ChatGPT**.
We recommend signing into your ChatGPT account to use Codex as part of your Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise plan.
You can also use Codex with an API key, but this requires additional setup.
